short_description:
In September 2022 a hacker leaked about 90 early GTA 6 clips. His setup: a hotel TV, an Amazon Fire Stick and a phone, while out on bail. Rockstar told the court it cost about $5 million; in November 2026 he pleaded guilty to all charges. No leaked footage is shown. Full video on the channel ⬇️

Sources: GameSpot, Engadget, GamesRadar, PC Gamer, Shacknews, VGC.
